title: Mishka and Interesting sum
statementMd:
Little Mishka enjoys programming. Since her birthday has just passed, her friends decided to present her with array of non-negative integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ of $*n*$ elements!

Mishka loved the array and she instantly decided to determine its beauty value, but she is too little and can't process large arrays. Right because of that she invited you to visit her and asked you to process $*m*$ queries.

Each query is processed in the following way:

1. Two integers $*l*$ and $*r*$ ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$) are specified — bounds of query segment.
2. Integers, presented in array segment $[*l*, *r*]$ (in sequence of integers $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$) **even number of times**, are written down.
3. XOR-sum of written down integers is calculated, and this value is the answer for a query. Formally, if integers written down in point 2 are $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$, then Mishka wants to know the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0cc8f248d0d8ba12cd7ce3df549c99209199764b.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) — operator of exclusive bitwise OR.

Since only the little bears know the definition of array beauty, all you are to do is to answer each of queries presented.

## Input

The first line of the input contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the number of elements in the array.

The second line of the input contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — array elements.

The third line of the input contains single integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the number of queries.

Each of the next $*m*$ lines describes corresponding query by a pair of integers $*l*$ and $*r*$ ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$) — the bounds of query segment.

## Output

Print $*m*$ non-negative integers — the answers for the queries in the order they appear in the input.

## Note

In the second sample:

There is no integers in the segment of the first query, presented even number of times in the segment — the answer is $0$.

In the second query there is only integer $3$ is presented even number of times — the answer is $3$.

In the third query only integer $1$ is written down — the answer is $1$.

In the fourth query all array elements are considered. Only $1$ and $2$ are presented there even number of times. The answer is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f3bf9fdacb25bb19b17c017c532cd102cb4993c.png).

In the fifth query $1$ and $3$ are written down. The answer is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfacb216edbf76a77a805a5347ff40d88d70f384.png).
statementZhMd:
小米什卡喜欢编程。由于她刚刚过完生日，她的朋友们决定送给她一个由 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 组成的、包含 $*n*$ 个元素的非负整数数组！

米什卡非常喜欢这个数组，并立即决定计算它的美丽值，但她还太小，无法处理很大的数组。正因如此，她邀请你来帮助她处理 $*m*$ 个查询。

每个查询按以下方式处理：

1. 指定两个整数 $*l*$ 和 $*r*$（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$）——查询区间的边界。
2. 将数组区间 $[*l*, *r*]$（即整数序列 $*a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r*}$）中出现**偶数次**的整数写下来。
3. 计算写下的整数的异或和，该值即为查询的答案。形式化地说，如果第 2 步写下的整数为 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*k*}$，那么米什卡想知道 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0cc8f248d0d8ba12cd7ce3df549c99209199764b.png) 的值，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 是按位异或运算符。

由于只有小熊们知道数组美丽值的定义，你要做的就是回答给出的每个查询。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$）——数组中元素的数量。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——数组中的元素。

输入的第三行包含一个整数 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1 000 000$）——查询的数量。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*l*$ 和 $*r*$（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$），表示对应查询的区间边界。

## 输出格式

按照查询在输入中出现的顺序，输出 $*m*$ 个非负整数，表示每个查询的答案。

## 说明

在第二个样例中：

第一个查询的区间中，没有整数出现偶数次，因此答案为 $0$。

在第二个查询中，只有整数 $3$ 出现偶数次，因此答案为 $3$。

在第三个查询中，只有整数 $1$ 被写下，因此答案为 $1$。

在第四个查询中，考虑了整个数组。只有 $1$ 和 $2$ 出现偶数次。答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f3bf9fdacb25bb19b17c017c532cd102cb4993c.png)。

在第五个查询中，写下了 $1$ 和 $3$。答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfacb216edbf76a77a805a5347ff40d88d70f384.png)。
